documentProfile: Philosophical nonfiction about responsibility in shared life, combining hypothetical scenes, moral argument and carefully qualified empirical research. Preserve first-person authorial claims, rhetorical questions, the distinction between explaining conduct and excusing it, and uncertainty about evidence. Use natural readable English without adding interpretations. Bibliographic numeric anchors are protected by the template; segment-end '[' is intentional.
review: First chunk reviewed against every source segment: no omitted paragraphs, numbers or qualifying distinctions; person references and hypothetical framing retained.
